decision: Drop of 5 grid positions for the next Race in which the driver participates. 2 penalty points (total of 7 for the 12 month period).
fact: Car 18 collided with Car 31 in Turn 1
offence: Breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV, Article 2 d) of the FIA International Sporting Code.
penalty: Drop of 5 grid positions for the next Race in which the driver participates. 2 penalty points (total of 7 for the 12 month period).
reason: The Stewards heard from the driver of Car 18 (Lance Stroll), the driver of Car 31 (Esteban Ocon), team representatives and reviewed video and in-car video evidence. Car 18 attempted an inside overtake on Car 31 into Turn 1 but misjudged the braking point and collided with Car 31. The Stewards determine that the driver of Car 18 is wholly at fault and apply a penalty accordingly. As the driver to be penalized did not finish the race a grid penalty equalling a 10 seconds time penalty is imposed.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 18 Causing A Collision With Car 31
to: The Team Manager, Aston Martin Aramco F1 Team
